verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for an office suite, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence pack documents one in LibreOffice. The headless mode, UNO API, macros and LanguageTool support are external-control, scripting or grammar-checking features, not an in-product assistant you can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
